Name: HuntersLunch
Overview:
The wastelands are a dangerous place, filled with wolves and monsters ready to turn anyone foolish enough to venture there into a handy meal. A young girl named Natsuki has ended up stranded there after her buggy broke down, and must now navigate the rough terrain and find a path to safety.

HuntersLunch is a puzzle game similar to classics like Adventures of Lolo and Sokoban, and is a sequel to SummerVacation. Each single-screen stage is a puzzle where you must reach the goal, and is filled with various tools to help you, terrain to traverse, and enemies to get in your way. You can only cross rocky terrain using a buggy, but can only cross spiked land on foot; rocks can be destroyed with hammers, bridges can let you cross water, and drums can be pushed around to block attacks or fill holes dug with a shovel.

The game includes 30 different puzzles to solve, and will save a replay of your most efficient solution for each puzzle. There are also five different BGM tracks to choose from, and two characters to play as, as well as Natsuki's original outfit from SummerVacation.
